d: Brazil's Supreme Court has ordered an investigation into alleged foreign involvement in former presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro's 2026 election campaign. At the centre of the probe is Rockbridge Network, a US-based conservative donor group co-founded by US Vice President JD Vance and Republican businessman Chris Buskirk. Investigators are examining whether foreign money, campaign services, political advertising or other resources were used to support Bolsonaro's campaign.
